deals.title: Dell XPS 13.4" 3K Touchscreen Laptop for $550 + free shipping
deals.sourceText: This new Dell XPS 13.4" laptop is selling for just $550 via Best Buy's eBay outlet. That's $50 under our mention from July, which was for teachers and students only, and the best deal we've seen for this build. It includes 8GB of memory and a 512GB solid state drive, and the manufacturer warranty covers parts and labor for one year. Shipping is free, too. Buy Now at eBay Features Groundbreaking laptop design Effortless portability for mobile users Seamless technology integration High-performance innovative hardware Commitment to premium build quality

deals.title: ASUS Vivobook 16 Ryzen 5 3501U 16" Laptop for $350 + free shipping
deals.sourceText: Best Buy is selling this new ASUS Vivobook 16 laptop through eBay for $350. That's a $250 drop when add it to cart and the best deal we've seen for this build. The 16" screen runs at 1920 x 1200 resolution, and the laptop comes with a 1-year manufacturer warranty on parts and labor. Shipping is free, too. Buy Now at eBay Features AMD Ryzen 5 3501U processor 8GB memory 256GB SSD storage 16" WUXGA display (1920 x 1200) Windows 11 Home 1-year parts & labor manufacturer warranty

deals.title: Canon EOS R5 Full-Frame Mirrorless Camera for $2,599 + free shipping
deals.sourceText: Amazon has the Canon EOS R5 for just $2,599 right now, which is its best-ever price. (The price is for the camera only, not lenses.) It shoots 8K video and 45-megapixel stills, with up to 20 fps burst shooting using the silent electronic shutter. Shipping is free, too. Buy Now at Amazon Features full-frame 45MP CMOS sensor 8K DCI video capture (up to 29.97fps) mechanical shutter up to 12fps Dual Pixel CMOS AF II autofocus Canon RF lens mounting 3.2" tilting LCD display

deals.title: Refurb Unlocked Apple iPhone 12 64GB Smartphone for $177 + free shipping
deals.sourceText: This refurbished iPhone 12 is $176.99, which is around $20 less than you'd pay for a refurb at Amazon. It's factory unlocked, so it works with any major carrier, and comes with Apple's A14 Bionic chip and a 12.0 MP camera system. The listing notes Good condition, meaning it may show moderate signs of wear like light scratches. A 30-day warranty applies, although it's not clear who backs it. deals.sourceText: The ASUS VA34VCPSR UltraWide curved monitor is being sold by Newegg via AliExpress for $392. But, you can use the promo code "USAFF70" to cut an extra $70 off and bring the price down to $322. That's $38 cheaper than Amazon's price. It pairs a QHD display with USB-C docking, a built-in Ethernet port, and a height-adjustable stand. Free shipping from the US is included and the deal ends on November 18. New to AliExpress? Our guide on AliExpress Promo Codes will help you find the best codes and navigate how to use them.
